title: Why Is Snow White?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Is Snow White.
Many flakes bounce light in all directions.
Let me show you that in 3D.
All colors bounce, so we see white.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Piled ice can look white like crushed glass.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: A snowflake is clear ice.
The pictures today are a new snow world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why is snow white.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
